completion_decisions: Retain all five Table-1 ENERCON turbine specifications exactly.
Complete each missing manufacturer curve with a monotone cubic energy-law interpolation anchored to the Case-3 theoretical outputs and rated point.
Derive one axial-induction value per type from its published power anchor through actuator-disk CP and freeze it outside evaluator loops.
Use exact circle intersection, root-sum-square deficits, and the lineage-standard Jensen expansion coefficient k=0.075.
Use the paper's directional and omnidirectional spacing logic, treating directional crosswind ratios as total widths.
Reconstruct the unavailable Sha Chau speed marginal from Figure 21 and three direction modes from Figure 20 as a deterministic 36-by-27 joint distribution.
Reuse T62 lineage defaults of 20 chromosomes per deme, tournament-2, one-point crossover, one elite per deme, and 20-generation ring migration.
Use counter-keyed random events, fixed-index writes, and ordered elite/migration commits to preserve one/all-core scientific identity.

optimized_roles: Case 4 directional five-type Sha Chau wind climate

decision_and_constraints.encoding: 20-bit x and 20-bit y coordinate per turbine
decision_and_constraints.case_3_and_4_turbines: 45 turbines, nine of each of five ENERCON types
decision_and_constraints.omnidirectional_spacing: both turbines inactive below 5 times the larger rotor diameter
decision_and_constraints.directional_spacing: downstream target inactive within 5 source diameters and the declared total crosswind width

physics.wind_shear: paper power law by turbine hub height
physics.wake: 2-D Jensen with hub-height distance, exact partial overlap, and root-sum-square deficits
physics.power: type-specific monotone cubic energy-law completion through published anchor and rated point

algorithm.lineage: paper MPGA plus audited T62 declared completions
algorithm.crossover: one-point bit crossover with deme-specific probability 0.7 through 0.9
algorithm.mutation: independent bit mutation with deme-specific probability 0.001 through 0.05, implemented by geometric skipping
algorithm.migration: best chromosome ring migration every 20 generations
algorithm.paper_stopping: best total output unchanged for 500 generations

physical_fes_ledger.unit: one complete spacing, wake, power, and feasibility evaluation of one physical layout
physical_fes_ledger.variation_selection_and_migration: do not consume physical wind-farm FES

hpc_execution.single_run: one persistent all-core worker team parallelizes initialization, offspring construction, and complete physical layout evaluations
hpc_execution.evaluator_optimizations: direction-grouped geometry, state-type inflow and no-wake-power precomputation, type-level axial precomputation, and exact shared physics
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: counter-keyed random events, fixed-index writes, and ordered elite and migration commits preserve one/all-worker scientific identity
hpc_execution.formal_resource_rule: one optimization process owns every Waffle CPU core; cases and seeds run sequentially
hpc_execution.timings: physical evaluator, algorithm-only, and end-to-end wall times are reported separately
